itens.descricao: Resolves the first usable transport adapter from a list of names or functions, throwing an AxiosError when none of the candidates is suitable.
itens.motivo: getAdapter iterates names or functions, resolves known adapters, breaks on the first usable one, and throws AxiosError (ERR_NOT_SUPPORT) if none is suitable.
itens.trecho: `There is no suitable adapter to dispatch the request ` + s,

itens.descricao: Sends requests through the Fetch API, decoding percent-encoded URL credentials before composing auth and omitting the cache mode only when Request construction then succeeds.
itens.motivo: URL username/password are decoded with decodeURIComponentSafe before building auth. The cache key is deleted from requestDefaults only if that makes Request construction succeed; otherwise it is restored.
itens.trecho: // Only omit cache when that makes Request construction succeed.

itens.descricao: Sends requests with Node's http, https and http2 modules, managing proxy agents, redirects and keep-alive sockets, and caching CONNECT-tunneling agents per proxy config.
itens.motivo: The adapter uses http, https and http2 and handles proxy agents, redirects and keep-alive sockets. getTunnelingAgent caches HttpsProxyAgent instances per proxy config in tunnelingAgentCache.

itens.descricao: Rejects XHR responses with status 0 as ECONNABORTED 'Request aborted' unless the request URL uses the file: scheme.
itens.motivo: Status 0 rejects with ECONNABORTED 'Request aborted'. File reads are excluded by the URL scheme, the page origin scheme or responseURL, so the file: exemption holds.
itens.trecho: reject(new AxiosError('Request aborted', AxiosError.ECONNABORTED, config, request));

itens.descricao: Creates the default Axios instance and new instances from a config, then exposes the public helpers such as Cancel, AxiosError, all, spread and isAxiosError.
itens.motivo: createInstance builds the default instance and instance.create makes new ones from merged config. The module then exposes Cancel, AxiosError, all, spread and isAxiosError.

itens.descricao: Implements CancelToken, a cancellation handle that exposes a promise and throws CanceledError when cancellation has been requested.
itens.motivo: CancelToken exposes this.promise and throwIfRequested() throws this.reason, which is a CanceledError.

itens.descricao: Defines CanceledError as an AxiosError subclass that carries the ERR_CANCELED code and a __CANCEL__ flag, and defaults its message to canceled.
itens.motivo: CanceledError extends AxiosError, passes ERR_CANCELED, sets __CANCEL__ = true, and defaults the message to 'canceled' when it is nullish.
itens.trecho: super(message == null ? 'canceled' : message, AxiosError.ERR_CANCELED, config, request);

itens.descricao: Tests whether a thrown value is a cancellation by checking its __CANCEL__ flag, returning false for falsy inputs.
itens.motivo: isCancel returns a boolean from the __CANCEL__ flag and gives false for falsy values.

itens.descricao: Dispatches requests merged with instance defaults and recognizes header maps without consuming objects meant as literal values.
itens.motivo: _request merges config with this.defaults and dispatches it. isHeadersBucket recognizes header maps (plain objects, AxiosHeaders, branded look-alikes) without consuming literal objects.

itens.descricao: Defines AxiosError, which can replace sensitive config keys with a REDACTED marker and appends a wrapped error's stack to its own stack.
itens.motivo: toJSON replaces config keys listed in config.redact with REDACTED. AxiosError.from calls appendCauseStack, which appends the wrapped error's stack to its own.

itens.descricao: Stores the `__proto__` header under a case variant slot, because the inherited setter would otherwise discard it silently.
itens.motivo: The code stores `__proto__` under the case variant '__Proto__' (PROTO_HEADER_SLOT) because the inherited Object.prototype setter would silently discard it.

itens.descricao: Manages request and response interceptors by numeric ID, treating a nullish handlers value as an empty stack and ignoring IDs invalidated by clear.
itens.motivo: Interceptors are tracked by numeric IDs from nextId++. countHandlers treats a nullish handlers value as 0, and eject ignores IDs whose entry no longer matches the handlers array after clear.
itens.trecho: // Ignore IDs invalidated by clear or direct replacement of handlers.

itens.descricao: Throws an ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE AxiosError when params contain a circular reference, walking plain objects and arrays with a WeakSet.
itens.motivo: Iterative walk of plain objects/arrays using active and visited WeakSets; throws AxiosError with ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE on a cycle.

itens.descricao: Redacts userinfo, query values and fragments from URLs before they reach error messages, keeping scheme, host and path intact.
itens.motivo: The module's purpose is combining baseURL with a requested URL (buildFullPath); the redaction only occurs in the error message for malformed http(s) URLs missing '//'. It does not redact URLs generally, and the description omits the actual function. Also, the redaction is limited to that one error, not 'URLs before they reach error messages' in general.

itens.descricao: Builds a multipart FormData body with an axios- boundary, drawing random bytes from platform.generateString or crypto and rejecting runtimes without Blob support.
itens.motivo: Throws if Blob isn't a function, builds 'axios-' boundary from platform.generateString or crypto.getRandomValues, then delegates to formDataToBlob.

itens.descricao: Runs the selected adapter for a request, transforms the response data, and times adapter execution with performance.now() when available.
itens.motivo: Gets adapter, runs it, transforms response data, and times with performance.now() when available (falling back to Date.now).

itens.descricao: Merges two request configs through per-key strategies, with separate handling for headers and params, then checks merged params for circular references.
itens.motivo: mergeMap gives per-key strategies, headers use mergeHeaders, params use mergeParams which calls assertParamsAcyclic on the result.

itens.descricao: Exports a frozen list of eleven HTTP method names, including purge, link, unlink and query, shared by the client and default config.
itens.motivo: Frozen array of 11 methods including purge, link, unlink, query; used in Axios.js (client) and defaults/index.js.

itens.descricao: Copies FormData-generated headers onto request headers, limiting the copy to content-type and content-length when the policy is content-only.
itens.motivo: With policy 'content-only' only content-type and content-length are copied; otherwise all headers are set.

itens.descricao: Resolves or rejects a response by its status against validateStatus, mapping 4xx to ERR_BAD_REQUEST and other rejected statuses to ERR_BAD_RESPONSE.
itens.motivo: Rejection code is ERR_BAD_REQUEST for 4xx and ERR_BAD_RESPONSE otherwise, which matches, but it also resolves when status is falsy or validateStatus is missing; the claim 'by its status against validateStatus' omits this yet is not wrong... on re-check, the mapping and resolve/reject behaviour are all supported.

itens.descricao: Applies a list of transform functions to request or response data, passing each one normalized headers and falling back to the default config.
itens.motivo: Iterates fns, calling each with data, headers.normalize() and status; config is `this || defaults`.

itens.descricao: Defines the default request config, using an own-property lookup helper and a stringifySafely function for request body serialization.
itens.motivo: Defines defaults with an `own` own-property helper and stringifySafely used in transformRequest for JSON serialization.

itens.descricao: Holds the transitional option flags, such as silentJSONParsing, forcedJSONParsing and encodeBasicAuthUsername, with their default boolean values.
itens.motivo: Exports boolean flags including silentJSONParsing (true), forcedJSONParsing (true), encodeBasicAuthUsername (false).

itens.descricao: Exports the global FormData when present, otherwise the form-data package, selecting one FormData class for the current environment.
itens.motivo: Exports global FormData if defined, otherwise the form-data package.

itens.descricao: Exports the VERSION constant as the single string literal "1.21.1", with no other logic in this module.
itens.motivo: O módulo só tem uma exportação, a constante VERSION, com o literal "1.21.1" e sem outra lógica.

itens.descricao: Extends a Node Transform stream to emit progress events and limit throughput via maxRate, paced by a time window and chunk size.
itens.motivo: A classe estende stream.Transform e emite 'progress' com bytesSeen. A taxa é limitada por maxRate, com janela timeWindow e divisão dos chunks por chunkSize/readableHighWaterMark.

itens.descricao: Percent-encodes query parameter strings with a reserved-character map that turns spaces into plus signs, and serializes params through toFormData.
itens.motivo: encode() usa um charMap que converte '%20' em '+' (e restaura !'()~ como percent-encoded). O construtor serializa params com toFormData.

itens.descricao: Caches HTTP/2 sessions per authority, reusing one only while it is not destroyed or closed and its options deep-equal the request's options.
itens.motivo: As sessões ficam em this.sessions[authority]. Uma só é reutilizada se não estiver destroyed nem closed e se util.isDeepStrictEqual(sessionOptions, options) for verdadeiro.

itens.descricao: Exports a named map of HTTP status codes, marking PayloadTooLarge and UnprocessableEntity as deprecated aliases of newer names.
itens.motivo: O mapa de status exporta nomes nomeados. PayloadTooLarge e UnprocessableEntity têm @deprecated apontando para ContentTooLarge e UnprocessableContent.

itens.descricao: Prepends a default two-byte zlib header to the first chunk when it does not start with 0x78, passing later chunks through unchanged.
itens.motivo: No primeiro chunk não vazio, se chunk[0] !== 120 (0x78), ele envia o cabeçalho 0x78 0x9C antes do chunk. Depois _transform passa a ser __transform, que só repassa os chunks.

itens.descricao: Returns a wrapper that calls a function with a fixed this value, forwarding all arguments through apply.
itens.motivo: Retorna a função wrap, que chama fn.apply(thisArg, arguments), fixando o this e repassando todos os argumentos.

itens.descricao: Appends serialized params to a URL while keeping reserved characters like colon and comma readable, and honors custom serializers, so generated query strings stay compact and predictable.
itens.motivo: encode() restaura %3A, %24 e %2C para ':', '$' e ',' (e %20 para '+'). buildURL aceita um serializador customizado via options.serialize ou options como função, e anexa os params à URL.

itens.descricao: Wraps an async function into a Node-style callback function, passing the error first and optionally reducing the resolved value.
itens.motivo: Para uma função async, retorna um wrapper que tira o callback dos args e o chama como cb(null, value), ou cb(null, ...reducer(value)) se houver reducer. Em caso de rejeição chama cb(err). Funções não async são devolvidas sem mudança.

itens.descricao: Joins a base URL and a relative path with exactly one slash, trimming trailing slashes from the base and leading slashes from the relative part.
itens.motivo: Remove as barras finais da base, remove as barras iniciais de relativeURL e junta os dois com uma única '/'. Se relativeURL for vazio, devolve baseURL.

itens.descricao: Merges several cancel signals and an optional timeout into one AbortController, wrapping reasons as CanceledError or AxiosError.
itens.motivo: Cria um único AbortController para vários signals e um timeout opcional. Ao abortar, passa o motivo como AxiosError (por exemplo ETIMEDOUT) ou o embrulha em CanceledError.
itens.trecho: new CanceledError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : err)

itens.descricao: Reads and writes browser cookies, using a split-based lookup rather than a RegExp built from the cookie name.
itens.motivo: Em ambiente de navegador padrão, write e read usam document.cookie. read faz split(';') e compara o nome com indexOf('='), sem montar RegExp a partir do nome.

itens.descricao: Logs a console.warn deprecation message naming the method and its replacement, and swallows any error thrown while logging it.
itens.motivo: Calls console.warn with the method name and, if given, an 'Use `instead`' hint; the whole body is inside try/catch that ignores errors.

itens.descricao: Estimates the decoded byte length of data: URLs without allocating large buffers, counting base64 padding and valid percent-encoded bytes.
itens.motivo: Computes sizes by scanning char codes (no buffers), handling '=' padding and valid %XX triplets as one byte.

itens.descricao: Converts FormData to a multipart Blob, normalizing line endings in string fields to CRLF and counting UTF-8 bytes without building encoded copies.
itens.motivo: Builds a Blob from FormData, normalizes string values to CRLF, and stringBytes counts UTF-8 bytes from char codes without encoding.

itens.descricao: Converts FormData entries into nested JSON by splitting bracket and dot paths, keeping segments such as user-name literal and enforcing a depth limit.
itens.motivo: parsePropPath splits on '.' and bracket groups while keeping other characters (user-name) literal; throwIfDepthExceeded enforces the max depth.

itens.descricao: Streams FormData as a multipart Readable, building each part's Content-Disposition header with escaped names and filenames taken from Blob values.
itens.motivo: FormDataPart builds Content-Disposition with escapeName(name) and, for non-string values, filename from value.name escaped; returns a Readable.

itens.descricao: Decodes RFC 2397 data: URIs into a Buffer or Blob, applying the spec default mediatype, so inline payloads work in Node the same as in browsers.
itens.motivo: The spec default mediatype (text/plain;charset=US-ASCII) is not actually applied: with no type and no params, mime stays '' (bare `data:,`); only when params exist is 'text/plain' prefixed, and no charset=US-ASCII default is added.

itens.descricao: Tests whether a string is absolute by matching a scheme followed by // or a protocol-relative // prefix, returning false for non-strings.
itens.motivo: Returns false for non-strings; regex matches an optional scheme followed by ':' then '//', which covers scheme:// and protocol-relative //.

itens.descricao: Checks whether a value is an object with isAxiosError set to true, which identifies errors thrown by Axios.
itens.motivo: Returns utils.isObject(payload) && payload.isAxiosError === true.

itens.descricao: Compares protocol, host and port of a URL with the page origin in standard browsers, and returns a function that always answers true elsewhere.
itens.motivo: In a standard browser env it compares protocol, host and port with the page origin; otherwise exports () => true.
itens.trecho: origin.protocol === url.protocol && origin.host === url.host && origin.port === url.port

itens.descricao: Strips leading control and space characters and removes tab, newline and carriage return from a URL before its protocol is checked, matching WHATWG parsing.
itens.motivo: Skips leading chars <= 0x20 (control/space) and removes all tab, LF, CR, as WHATWG URL parsing does.

itens.descricao: Exports null as a stand-in module, so the browser build can swap out Node-only adapters through the package browser field without pulling in Node built-ins.
itens.motivo: File only does `export default null`; package.json's browser field maps http adapter, Buffer and FormData node classes to ./lib/helpers/null.js.

itens.descricao: Parses raw HTTP header text into an object, ignoring duplicate values for a fixed list of names that Node also discards, and avoiding inherited setters.
itens.motivo: Splits raw text by newline, skips duplicates for keys in ignoreDuplicateOf (Node's discard list), and uses Object.create(null) to avoid inherited setters like __proto__.

itens.descricao: Extracts the lowercased scheme of 1 to 25 word characters or - or +, returning an empty string when none matches.
itens.motivo: The regex accepts 1-25 chars of [-+\w] followed by ':', the match is lowercased, and '' is returned when there is no match.

itens.descricao: Turns raw progress events into throttled progress objects with loaded, total, rate and estimated values, computed with a speedometer.
itens.motivo: It returns a throttled function that builds data with loaded, total, rate (from speedometer) and estimated, then calls the listener.

itens.descricao: Yields a Blob's contents as an async generator, preferring stream(), then arrayBuffer(), then async iteration, and finally the raw value.
itens.motivo: The generator tries stream(), then arrayBuffer(), then Symbol.asyncIterator, and finally yields the blob itself.

itens.descricao: Resolves the final request config, building basic auth and the full URL, and adds the XSRF header only in standard browser environments.
itens.motivo: It merges the config, sets the Basic Authorization header, builds the full URL with buildFullPath/buildURL, and only sets the XSRF header inside the platform.hasStandardBrowserEnv block.

itens.descricao: Strips control bytes from header values and trims space and tab from their ends, with separate patterns for Unicode and byte-string values.
itens.motivo: There are two regexes: the Unicode one strips C0 controls (except tab) and DEL, and the byte-string one strips anything outside tab, 0x20-0x7e and 0x80-0xff. Both are followed by trimSPorHTAB, which trims space and tab.

itens.descricao: Decides whether a host bypasses the proxy by canonicalizing IPv4 shorthand, octal and hex forms, unmapping IPv4-mapped IPv6 and matching loopback names.
itens.motivo: normalizeIPAddress handles shorthand, octal and hex IPv4, unmapIPv4MappedIPv6 unmaps mapped IPv6, and isLoopback matches loopback names and addresses.

itens.descricao: Estimates transfer rate from a ring buffer of byte counts and timestamps, returning nothing until the minimum sampling window has elapsed.
itens.motivo: It keeps circular arrays of bytes and timestamps. It returns undefined until now - firstSampleTS reaches min, and after that it returns the rate.

itens.descricao: Wraps a callback so it receives an array as its arguments, mirroring Function.prototype.apply with a null this value.
itens.motivo: It returns a function that takes an array and calls callback.apply(null, arr).

itens.descricao: Returns a throttled call plus flush and flushWith helpers that invoke the wrapped function at most freq times per second, keeping the latest arguments.
itens.motivo: It returns [throttled, flush, flushWith], with threshold = 1000/freq. Calls inside the window store lastArgs and fire on a timer, and flush and flushWith invoke immediately.

itens.descricao: Converts nested objects and arrays into FormData or URLSearchParams with bracket or dot key paths, using a nesting limit of 100 by default that maxDepth overrides.
itens.motivo: It builds keys with bracket or dot paths via renderKey and the dots option, and maxDepth defaults to DEFAULT_FORM_DATA_MAX_DEPTH = 100 and can be overridden. The target defaults to FormData, but any append-capable target such as URLSearchParams can be passed, as toURLEncodedForm does.

itens.descricao: Serializes data into URL-encoded form text through toFormData, encoding Node Buffers as base64 strings instead of raw bytes.
itens.motivo: It calls toFormData with a URLSearchParams target, and a visitor that appends Buffers as base64 strings when running on Node.

itens.descricao: Wraps a stream into a ReadableStream that re-chunks bytes to a chunk size, reports progress, and calls onFinish only once.
itens.motivo: It reads bytes through readBytes/streamChunk, which splits chunks to chunkSize. It reports cumulative progress through onProgress, and the _onFinish guard with the done flag makes onFinish fire only once. It returns a ReadableStream.

itens.descricao: Validates config option types against a schema and builds transitional validators that warn about deprecated options, using hasOwnProperty for lookups.
itens.motivo: assertOptions checks option types against the schema, and validators.transitional builds validators that warn about deprecated options (console.warn once per option). The schema lookup uses hasOwnProperty.

itens.descricao: Exports the global Blob constructor when available and null otherwise, for use by the browser platform index.
itens.motivo: The file default-exports the global Blob if it is defined, and null otherwise.
itens.trecho: export default typeof Blob !== 'undefined' ? Blob : null;

itens.descricao: Exports the global FormData constructor when available and null otherwise, for use by the browser platform index.
itens.motivo: The file default-exports the global FormData if it is defined, and null otherwise.
itens.trecho: export default typeof FormData !== 'undefined' ? FormData : null;

itens.descricao: Exports the native URLSearchParams when defined, falling back to AxiosURLSearchParams in environments that lack it.
itens.motivo: The file exports native URLSearchParams when it is defined, and falls back to AxiosURLSearchParams otherwise.
itens.trecho: export default typeof URLSearchParams !== 'undefined' ? URLSearchParams : AxiosURLSearchParams;

itens.descricao: Exports the browser platform object with isBrowser set to true, its class selection, and a protocols list covering http, https, file, blob, url and data.
itens.motivo: The default export has isBrowser: true, a classes object (URLSearchParams, FormData, Blob), and a protocols list with exactly http, https, file, blob, url and data.

itens.descricao: Detects standard browser and web worker environments and exposes the page URL href as origin, falling back to http://localhost without a window.
itens.motivo: The file computes hasStandardBrowserEnv and hasStandardBrowserWebWorkerEnv. It sets origin to window.location.href when a browser env exists and to 'http://localhost' otherwise.

itens.descricao: Spreads the common utilities and the Node platform bindings into one default export used across adapters and helpers.
itens.motivo: The default export spreads the common utils and then the Node platform object into a single object.

itens.descricao: Exposes isBufferAvailable and from helpers that wrap the global Buffer, so callers can check support before creating buffers.
itens.motivo: The module exports isBufferAvailable(), which checks typeof Buffer, and from(), which calls Buffer.from. Callers can check support before creating buffers.

itens.descricao: Re-exports the form-data package's FormData class as the FormData implementation of the Node platform.
itens.motivo: The file imports FormData from the 'form-data' package and re-exports it as the default.

itens.descricao: Re-exports Node's url.URLSearchParams as the URLSearchParams class used by the Node platform descriptor.
itens.motivo: The file re-exports url.URLSearchParams from Node's url module as the default. The Node platform index imports it into its classes.

itens.descricao: Builds the Node platform descriptor with a crypto-based generateString using randomFillSync and a Blob reference when one is available.
itens.motivo: The generateString function fills a Uint32Array with crypto.randomFillSync. The classes object includes Blob when it is defined, and null otherwise.

itens.descricao: Provides generic helpers for type checks and safe property access, treating inherited terminal prototypes as fail-closed boundaries during traversal.
itens.motivo: The file holds generic type checks (isArray, isString, and others) and safe-access helpers (getSafeProp, hasOwnInPrototypeChain). isPrototypeBoundary treats Object.prototype, and any non-source object whose prototype is null, as a fail-closed boundary, as the doc comment says.
